title: Mapping a machine's output
statement: Let $M$ be a nondeterministic $k$-tape machine and let $f$ map symbols to optional symbols. The machine obtained by mapping its output through $f$ keeps the same initial state and, in each transition, keeps every part of the action unchanged except its optional output symbol, which is replaced by the result of applying $f$ to it and flattening the optional value.
hypotheses_covered: A function from symbols to optional symbols
